summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of its at-the-market offering agreement with Chardan Capital Markets, originally entered June 23, 2025. The ATM was for up to $10,000,000 in ordinary shares; no shares were ever sold. Suspension effective June 10, 2026; termination effective July 22, 2026. No special situation—simply routine termination of an equity facility. No deal terms, premium, or strategic change. This is a standard corporate event, not a special situation.
